notes.A: A long aisle shows the counter, but a crate and shelf dominate the view.
notes.B: Shows the full counter and surrounding aisles, though the hanging meat looks small.
notes.C: Looks down the laden counter, with a broad blank wall competing for space.
notes.D: Shows meat and lanterns up close, but one carcass hides much of the room.
notes.E: Shows the hanging poultry and counter goods, with cropped carcasses crowding the frame.
notes.F: Shows the stocked shelving and aisle layout, with the meat counter barely visible.
notes.G: Shows the butcher’s display in context, though the far end fades into dark brick.
notes.H: Shows the counter between stocked shelves, but a foreground carcass blocks the aisle.

market_hall.best: G makes the hanging carcasses, lanterns, butcher’s counter, and stocked shelves readable together.
market_hall.lacks: The hall lacks a recognizable stall frontage. The butcher’s display reads as a table in an aisle of storage shelves.
market_hall.fix: Build a timber-framed butcher’s stall around the existing counter, with an open service front facing the main aisle.

blind_name.name: Butcher’s stall
blind_name.why: Large animal carcasses hang above a wooden counter, with stocked shelves and a checkered floor.
blind_name.odd: The smaller tan object hanging between the carcasses is hard to identify.
